name: @pipeworx/mcp-financial-datasets

tools.name: fd_institutional_holders
tools.description: Who holds <ticker> (institutional 13F holders) — the institutional investors (funds, asset managers) that report holding a stock in their latest SEC Form 13F. Returns investor name, shares held, market value, and report period. Example: fd_institutional_holders({ ticker: "AAPL", limit: 25, _apiKey: "your-key" })

tools.name: fd_investor_portfolio
tools.description: What does fund <investor> hold (institutional 13F portfolio) — every long position an institutional filer reported in its latest SEC Form 13F. Identified by the fund's 10-digit zero-padded SEC CIK (e.g. Berkshire Hathaway = 0001067983). Returns ticker, shares, market value, and report period per position. Example: fd_investor_portfolio({ filer_cik: "0001067983", limit: 50, _apiKey: "your-key" })

filer_cik.description: The fund's SEC filer CIK, 10-digit zero-padded, e.g. "0001067983" (Berkshire Hathaway). This endpoint requires a CIK, not a fund name.

tools.name: fd_insider_transactions
tools.description: Insider (Form 4) transactions for <ticker> — recent buys/sells by officers, directors, and 10%+ owners as reported on SEC Form 3/4/5. Returns insider name, title, transaction type, shares, price, date, and board-director flag. Example: fd_insider_transactions({ ticker: "AAPL", limit: 25, _apiKey: "your-key" })

tools.name: fd_filings
tools.description: Recent SEC filings for <ticker> — the company's latest EDGAR filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K). Returns filing type, report period, filing date, and document URL. Optionally filter by filing_type. Example: fd_filings({ ticker: "AAPL", filing_type: "8-K", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-financial-datasets forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the financial-datasets pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
